rule: Futures carry, time-series sign (KMPV 2018), signal C1 (21-session trailing mean of front/second annualised carry, lagged 1 session), monthly decisions, next-close fills, book: fx

columns.net_1x: daily excess return over T-bill net of the realistic cost map

vol_scaling: 10% annualised ex-ante via trailing 252-session sample covariance of daily instrument excess returns (min 60 obs), instruments normalised by EWMA vol (com 60); scale cap 4
selection: headline variant = highest in-sample net Sharpe among 4 global variants of this construction; class books use the same variant (no per-class selection)
